UNDERSTANDING INTERACTIVE LISTENING
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding interactive listening means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Interactive listening.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Begin with something you can point to at a kitchen in Kisumu. On “Understanding Interactive listening”, how would you explain interactive listening to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Identify general information from audio stimuli/texts,. Clue from real life: ● Listen to songs on my house. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• ● Listen to songs on my house.
• ● use digital devices to source.
• For videos on presentation of a.
• ● listen to presentations on my.
• ● play hide and seek games to.
• ● listen to instructions and put.

Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for FRENCH.[DIAGRAM]
